{{Conflicting|[[Showdown (LA Times)|''Showdown'']]|[[2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back'']]}}
[[File:Chewbacca-Docking_Bay_138.jpg|250px|thumb|Chewbacca waits in the ''Millennium Falcon'' as Skorr chases Han Solo through the docking bay]]
'''Docking Bay 138''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. [[2 ABY/Legends|One year before]] the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] encountered the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Skorr/Legends|Skorr]], who was attempting to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on them by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], in Docking Bay 138.<ref name="One Year Earlier">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=One Year Earlier: Han Solo|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/112359/cid/7727279/2015-Topps-Star-Wars-Illustrated-The-Empire-Strikes-Back---One-Year-Earlier-OY-3-Han-Solo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The encounter described is mention in the "One Year Earlier" subset of the [[2015]] [[2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back'']] trading card set, placing it in 2 ABY. Despite its release date, the set is part of the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity. The incident here conflicts with the [[Showdown (LA Times)|''Showdown'']] story from ''[[Classic Star Wars]]'' which includes Skorr's death in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Showdown">"[[Showdown (LA Times)|Showdown]]"</ref>
